case_name: B.S. Minhas v Indian Statistical Institute & Ors.

statutes.act: Act Deals With Audit Of Accounts Of The Institute By Auditors Duly Qualified To Act

holding: The writ petition must succeed. The order of appointment dated 3rd August, 1979 of respondent No. 4 as the Director of respondent No. 1 is quashed and set aside.
